description: An example known-senders map; every vendor and domain here is made up (.test domains). The engine checks "vendors" in order and the first match wins, so put a specific sender before a general one that would also match (a marketplace before its parent company). Each vendor has a "name" (the clean name the vendor field gets), "domains" (matched as whole domain names anywhere in the text) and "patterns" (regular expressions, case-insensitive). "header_lines": n looks only at the first n lines of page 1. "kind" tags an entry so only a profile field asking for that kind ("known_vendor": "lender") uses it; fields asking for any sender ("known_vendor": true) skip nothing. "capture": true takes the name from the pattern's first group instead of "name". "stripe" finds the business name on a hosted invoice (the cell before "Bill to") when no vendor matched; "events" finds an event's heading on a registration receipt. A host may add keys of its own to a vendor entry and read them with fields.sender_entry(name); the engine ignores them.
